risk_fixes: Save-PcCareReportPair previously appended unsanitized FileBase to selected candidate directory; a slash or '..' could redirect the target outside REPORTS.
diagnose.ps1 previously cast optional storage Wear and Temperature directly to [int], accepting sentinel/out-of-range readings and allowing a malformed metric to suppress an independently valid one.

implementation.report_writer: FileBase strictly ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen, length 1..80, no dot/slash/absolute/relative segments. Validation precedes filesystem operations. Existing names still non-overwritable.
implementation.storage: Pure ConvertTo-PcCareStorageMetrics added to existing, ZIP-allowlisted telemetry_analysis.ps1. Independent wear 1..100 and temp 1..125 integral checks, invalid/zero/null unknown. diagnose.ps1 sources module once before accessing counters and no longer casts raw sensor values.
implementation.tests: report_io.tests.ps1 negative path-traversal/overlength fixtures; telemetry_analysis.tests.ps1 independent numeric/sentinel/PII fixtures; test_package.py source contract guards. All synthetic until Windows execution.

safety: Feature branch only. No customer device/files touched, no repair or backup executed, no main/Cloudflare deployment.
